reviews.review:
This is how you do a 40K game right. Relic nailed everything, from the feel of running in power armor, to the combat which feels brutal and heavy. The sound of the bolt gun is pure perfection. They even managed to actually get the lore right for the Melta, which really "warmed" my heart. 

The story is good. You have a space marine captain, his two closest friends, one a veteran and the other a fresh out of the scouts noob. But, both are good. Well written and well acted. Which, by the way, the voice acting in this game is really good. I don't know if it was design or they just got lucky, but the VAs and the script are wonderful. 

The combat is amazing fun and the world is quite detailed. The graphics in this game still hold up today, everything from the design of the Hab blocks, to the great bridge and orbital tether (praise the omnissiah!) look and feel as though they belong on Graia. They really did nail the atmosphere. I won't go into spoilers, but it's not just orks that have come to this world...beware what lurks in the warp! 

The MP was fun, I know there is still a small group playing. You can usually set up games via discussion boards or reddit and the MP while being a little bit clunky was and is still a lot of fun. The Hoard survival mode itself is a blast to play with friends and strangers alike. 

The most criminal thing about this game is that it probably will never get the sequel that it deserves. There are some unanswered questions that still bug me to this day. I'd even go so far as to say the game is still worth it even at full price, but if you get it on a sale you won't be upset at all! 

Honest score, solid 8/10!
